units.source_text: 奇怪的是，建造房屋的那部分一点也不高出路面。

en.t: Strangely, the part where the houses were built did not rise above the road surface at all.

units.source_text: 只有道路在不断变高，村落本身始终是平坦的。

en.t: Only the road kept getting higher, while the village itself remained flat.

units.source_text: 其实，不仅是路，建筑物与建筑物之间的隔离带，也和路面一般高低。

en.t: In fact, it was not only the road; the strips separating one building from another were also level with the road surface.

units.source_text: 看上去，村落整体仿佛呈上坡趋势，只有建筑物原封不动地留在了平地上。

en.t: It looked as though the whole village were sloping upward, while only the buildings had been left exactly as they were on level ground.

units.source_text: 这个印象越往前走越清晰；

en.t: The farther he went, the clearer this impression became;

units.source_text: 不久，所有的房子看起来，都像从沙的斜坡上掏挖下去，建造在沙窝里似的。

en.t: Before long, all the houses looked as if they had been dug down into the sandy slope and built inside hollows in the sand.

units.source_text: 而且，沙的斜坡比屋顶要高得多。

en.t: What was more, the sandy slope was much higher than the roofs.

units.source_text: 一排排房子，仿佛稳稳地坐在沙窝深处。

en.t: Rows of houses seemed to sit solidly deep inside the hollows of sand.
